decisions.reason: The candidate already records the same message's separate decision to omit header navigation; adding footer links does not further change that state.

The source establishes where future page links will appear but provides no change to responsive behavior or breakpoint guidance.
The footer-link strategy does not change any design-token category, value, font asset, width, or interaction-state requirement.
Public website footer links do not affect the provisioning wizard's styling guidance or responsive orientations.
